name.ja: HG 1/72 アメインゴースト

description.ja: 「境界戦機」より、謎に包まれた漆黒のAMAIM(アメイン)ゴーストが登場！
description.en: From "Kyoukai Senki" comes the mysterious jet-black AMAIM Ghost!

description.ja: ■KEN OKUYAMA DESIGNによる可動構造の検証を経て立体化された謎多きAMAIM。
description.en: • The mysterious AMAIM was made into three-dimensional form after verification of its movable structure by KEN OKUYAMA DESIGN.

description.ja: ■脚部の特徴的な構造によりアクション性の高いキットとなっている。
description.en: • The unique structure of the legs makes this kit highly actionable.

description.ja: ■背部のジャミングユニットの可動・開閉が可能。
description.en: • The jamming unit on the back can be moved and opened/closed.

description.ja: ■左右異なる腕部形状、頭部のカメラアイも精密に表現。
description.en: • The different arm shapes on the left and right sides and the camera eye on the head are also precisely expressed.

description.ja: ■手足の爪の色、及び可動もパーツ分割により再現。
description.en: • The color and movement of the fingernails and toenails are also reproduced by dividing the parts.

description.ja: ■右手は武器持ち手として手甲パーツをスライドし、ナックルモードを再現。別売りの「境界戦機」商品の武装も一部装備可能。
description.en: • The right hand can be used as a weapon holder by sliding the gauntlet parts to recreate knuckle mode. It can also be equipped with some weapons from the separately sold "Kyoukai Senki" products.
